t: Tell Mark Staritsin about the victory in Nihaz's Citadel

Let me sum up what you managed to find out:

Nihaz must have wanted to create a new world, but he couldn't, because Darkness is not capable of creating new things - it can only distort what already exists.

But there are many other gods - each of them embodies a certain aspect of power, and they all participate in the cycle of Creation and Destruction, reforming the universe bit by bit.

Wishing to acquire this power, Nihaz started the Great War, and the imprisonment of Sarn and creation of Sarnaut were only a part of his plans.

And now we have a fraction of this power. Can we make the best use of it? Only time will tell.

I ask you not to tell Yasker anything about this. It's too early, and when the right time comes, I'll summon you myself.

Nevertheless, you need to inform the Citadel of your victory. This is a great victory, and it is yours.

Excellent, my friend!

Another victory, another success.

I hope our world is safe for now... However, Catherina has sent us a message - they are planning to build something on our Suslanger... Yasker has already given his consent. Now the League and the Empire are united as never before, and together we can handle anything.

 And you - you can rest now.

That’s right. I must say these lands are much prettier that those under the gray skies of Xadagan.

I remember how they called me the Arisen-Who-Lived. I’ve had so many other names since then...

The world changes, and only one thing stays the same - idiots are fighting idiots. There’s no secret that I put my hopes on the Aoidoi.

They are way too pure and naive for war. They can put an end to this! We all should finally learn the lessons of the past.
And I remember you, too. I can’t say those are pleasant memories.
h: I remember you from the Holy Land!

t: Nefer Ur looks at you, waiting for something.

I see. Another world, a world where the Sparks go... Interesting.

After learning about Nihaz and Sarn, I assumed that sooner or later we would meet other gods who are just as cruel and indifferent to the interests of mortals.

But it turns out that everything that exists is the result of some goddess's actions... The goddess who wants to continue the eternal cycle of Life and Death.

I need to think about this.
h: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

t: Tell Lovewise Catfish about the victory in Nihaz's Citadel

Let me sum up what you managed to find out:

Nihaz must have wanted to create a new world, but he couldn't, because Darkness is not capable of creating new things - it can only distort what already exists.

But there are many other gods - each of them embodies a certain aspect of power, and they all participate in the cycle of Creation and Destruction, reforming the universe bit by bit.

Wishing to acquire this power, Nihaz started the Great War, and the imprisonment of Sarn and creation of Sarnaut were only a part of his plans.

And now we have a fraction of this power. Can we make the best use of it? Only time will tell.

I ask you not to tell Aidenus anything about this. It's too early, and when the right time comes, I'll summon you myself.

Nevertheless, you need to inform the Citadel of your victory. This is a great victory, and it is yours.

I never doubted you!

Another victory, another success.

I hope our world is safe for now... However, Catherina has sent us a message - they are planning to build something on our Suslanger...

The League will also be involved, of course. And you - you can rest now.
Do what is necessary to remove Galenel's seal.

Damnation. Something's not right. There's an intruder in my tower. Perhaps he's the one making things difficult for you and Dakkar. You need to deal with it as soon as possible.

It's not easy to get into my tower - the entrance is sealed with a spell.

But I have a special crystal... I found it during the search for a Magic Source on Yazes. It can focus the energy of a spell.

We can use it to lift the seal and get inside. I still remember how it's done. Give me some time...
It worked! So I still have some power left...
This seal is protecting my tower. No one can pass through it, not even I.

I... I don’t know. The crystal just exploded in my hands. I've grown so weak over the centuries... But I'll think of something.

But nothing will work without a crystal. The shards are down there, on the bottom of the rift. I only have one... Take it. The shards are pulled towards each other. This shard will help you find the rest on the bottom of the rift.

To combine them into a whole crystal, you'll need extra magical energy. I sense echoes of magic among the shards on the bottom - they'll serve as a good energy source.

Go. And come back soon.
Enter Galenel's tower and find out what's happening inside.
Go! The path is clear! It's easier to enter the tower now.

It can't be... That ghost took Dakkar! Your friend is a powerful summoner, but he still fell into a trap.

What do we do now...?
Help Galenel find her lost memories in the Tower.

Let me think...

Yes. Yes... We must find it. Find the ghost and free Dakkar.

I used to know my Tower so well. But now I can't even remember where this spirit has come from and where it could be hiding.

Perhaps my memories will awaken if we go down and explore the tower...

Such treachery... I was so blind! The vision I saw frightened me, and that fear blinded me to the real threat.

I still can't remember what happened during the ritual... The answer is somewhere behind that door.
Free the restless souls of sorcerers, crusaders, and trackers.

But it won't be easy to open it. Souls are guarding it - the dead that are aimlessly wandering the halls of the tower. They are around us, see?

Of course you don't. I'll teach you. Go now - and free them.

There they are, whirling around the room! Echoes of lives past... That ghost tricked them so it could hide in its lair.

But now they'll help us.
Catch wandering souls and open the door

This door is protected by a magical seal. Or rather, multiple seals connected to the souls of the ghosts that dwelled here. You can see the remains of those unfortunate people everywhere - marauders that must have tried to solve that ghost's riddle and break into the storage. Naive amateurs!

But we won't repeat their mistakes. Look there - see that book near the far wall? I took a look when you weren't around. It's the Book of Souls that contains the names of all fallen defenders of the tower and Veligrad. When the bloody ghost seized the tower, he twisted the book's purpose and turned it into an artifact that can catch and hold souls. He used it to summon everyone who had ever lived in Veligrad to serve him. And he used their souls to seal the door to the storage.

But now we'll use the book to free the souls from this dark service and open the door. I'll tell you what to do. Use the book to capture the souls bound to the seal. It's not hard, you'll figure it out.

Just be careful! If you touch a wrong soul, I'll be in trouble.

Try not to get me killed, alright?

It worked!

I feel sorry for the souls that were used to create this seal... I hope they can rest in peace now.
It's behind that door... We must stop it at any cost! I'll help. Go!
I almost died... Thank you for your help. You and Galenel.

[Dakkar is muttering something, trying to warn you. He says something about a scroll. He's about to pass out, he's feeling worse.

With great difficulty, he moves his hand to give you something.

It's the Dead Bone Horn.]
h: Dakkar! What's going on? How do we free you?

t: Ask Galenel what happened in the Tower.
I wonder where Urd's soul shard has come from. Galenel should tell us.

I went to so much trouble to bring the scroll here and keep it from falling into the wrong hands... I still want to keep it safe. But my Tower can't protect anything anymore. And I'm so tired of guarding it all my life, even after death...

If you collect all three parts of the scroll, you can keep it. Dakkar will be a worthy successor. I hope power won't blind him the way it blinded Urd.

And now it's time for me to go. Farewell.
Go to Zayan at the outpost.

Now I understand what happened here. So two more parts are hidden somewhere on Umoir. I hope it won't take us too long to find these witches. Once we have all three parts, we can build an army that even Urd himself never dreamed of.

Well, we're finished here. I'll take care of the rest. Go to Zayan at the outpost and tell him to clear some space - soon we'll have reinforcements for the undead army.

Urd possessed Dakkar? I hope it won't affect his mind...

By the way, we established rapport with the vampires.
Talk to the disputants and report to Vseslav about the attacks of the locals on elves.

This is madness!

We've been here for a fortnight now, and everything was fine, and now half of the villagers hate us! You're not local? I have a bad memory for faces...

You know what? The headman must put a stop to it. They promised support, but instead they are kicking us out.

Please talk to them - perhaps they'll listen to you!

Go to Vseslav and ask him to handle it. Or else these heathens will rip us apart.

! Long time no see... It's been ages.

Elves, you say? I know, I know... But it's not that simple.
Ask the residents of Clear Valley about the situation with the elves.

It's a messy situation. The elves are here for a good reason. But they don't tell the locals anything, so the people speculate.

The strangest thing is that it only started recently. Elves are not something we see often, but they've never been treated with such hostility before. I think someone's behind this - someone who is instigating hatred. If I tell my people to play nice - they will turn on me as well, and then Clear Valley will be picked apart by the local nobility that can't wait to get their hands on the land. We need to get to the root of this issue.

But first, you should hear what the people are saying. Go talk to the locals, perhaps you'll learn something.

Nobility, you say? Oh, those people. Did they start this themselves or did someone have a hand in this? I still don't know. And you?

One thing is clear - someone is muddying the waters. I have a suspicion.
Explore the village and prevent fights between the elves and locals.

Listen. The people are clearly agitated. I'm worried something will happen. If they kill anyone, there will be a scandal!

We really don't need that now.

Be a dear - take a walk around the village, and if you see anyone fighting - break them up, you can even give someone a shiner if that helps. As long as there's no blood spilled.
Thank you, it should be safer on the streets for our guests now. I didn't think the villagers would get in a fight because of them. I hope no one's hurt.
Explore the village and prevent fights between the elves and locals.

It would seem the nobility stopped muddying the waters, but the locals still mistrust the elves. I don't know what our guests did to displease them.

In any case, we'll have to change the public's opinion. I'm afraid a kind word and a punch would be more effective than just a kind word.

Catherina will have our hide if they cause a diplomatic incident... So why don't you take a walk around the village, ? If you see anyone fighting - break them up and explain what's what. We should offer hospitality to our guests, not insults.
That’s good. If someone tries it again, they'll regret it.
Alright, guys! Hold the elf while I show this fool...
Check Jade's carts and find missing goods.

This is outrageous! They stole everything, like some kind of rats! In broad daylight! Where was Vseslav?

I gathered the best goods, made all preparations.

What do you mean, “so what”?! What about trade?

With the vampires, why? If you must know, they pay good money! Unlike the local crowd. Listen, let's check everything. I have a list. And if something is missing, can you find it?

And hurry up! We don't have much time, I need to get there and back before nightfall. If I don't make it, the bloodsuckers will eat me! Or worse, they'll ask for a discount.

Oh, a load off my mind! Everything is accounted for, we can keep going now.

What? Reward? What reward? I thought we were friends... Oh well. Let's consider it expenses on ensuring the security of my caravan.
Find Milosh and take him to Svetlana Valir.

Listen, . I have a job for you.

Yes, don't look so surprised! I need to find a man that used to serve my family. I know he lives somewhere around here, but I can't find him - a princess can't just run around and shout his name.

I need Milosh Seversky. When you find him - take him here immediately. You'll be rewarded.

Milosh, darling! Why is he so drunk... Oh well, there'll be none of that on duty.

Thank you for your help. See you around.

Look up. See them?

While the village was empty, bats settled in the houses. Now these cursed creatures fly around the village, spreading the Blight and sending the locals into a panic because the people associate them with vampires. Kill as many as you can.

Here's a handful of rocks for you - just in case. You can shoot the creatures down with them - you know what to do next.
Good work. If you have time to help with this flying menace again, come back here - you'll help Clear Valley a great deal.
Kill the blighted bats in Clear Valley.

Our people really dislike bats. They're scared of them.

Even though they are fairly harmless. But the Umoir ones are a different matter. They spread diseases and they are too big.

Even Danas suffered from them - because how would you hit those with a sword? It's easier with a bow. Or a rock.

To put it simply, , you've killed them before, so let's do it again. It will calm the people down and keep the vermin away.
Is it done? Great, there's less noise now.
Remove 7 bat amulets and report to Gala de Delice.

You are looking at a bat nailed to the fence with stakes. It looks like an improvised amulet against vampires invented by the locals. It will hardly repel bloodsuckers but it serves as a reminder to the villagers that vampires are their enemies. To help Gala de Delice's cause, you need to remove these amulets.
Oh... yes, I saw those horrible amulets. Poor creatures. They didn't deserve such cruelty. I hope some day I'll find a way to help humans and House de Doucer coexist peacefully.
Sneak into the house of the local nobility and eavesdrop on their conversation.

I feel uneasy. We need to know what they're planning.

The nobles live in separate quarters. They have guards. I know they gather at night and converse. I'd like to find out what they talk about. Listen, can you sneak inside and eavesdrop on them? Just look around, maybe you'll find something.

Wait until nightfall and go. And be careful - if the guards spot you, we'll be in trouble!
Have you learned all the secrets?

My suspicions appear to be correct...

Princess... hm... Is that Zarida? She never liked elves.

If Zarida is muddying the waters, that's very bad - she's Catherina's favorite apprentice and moving against her without evidence will be difficult.

I'll keep an eye on her. And you should be careful. Expect new trouble!
Bring the letter to the Tale Teller at the Clear Valley in Foul Dale.

An ancient page torn from a book served as a material for the letter. On one side, you see doodles by some goblins, and on the other - ancient writings written carefully by a true master chronicler.

You should show this page to someone who knows a thing or two about ancient legends. Maybe you should take it to the Tale Teller, and he'll tell you what's on it?

Oh, that's a rare one indeed. The chronicle of the Valir dynasty. I'm going to read it. Here, listen:

"Where the Kanian land came from"

We'll begin our story.

The Kanian nation is old, and no one knows where it originates. It is only known that, while Yul still existed, they lived in the northern forests and swamps full of game. Other nations kept away, because few knew the way across the deadly marshes.

The Aro - that's what the Kanians called themselves at the dawn of time - were a brave and strong nation. But other powers ruled the world then. Powerful Junes built their empire to the south of their territories. In the west, the Aro lands bordered the elven kingdom. The east with its boundless steppes was occupied by ruthless orcs.

None of them encroached on the Aro... Except the dragons, fire-breathing serpents that warred against all other nations. They attacked the ancestors of the Kanians as well. That was the era of legendary knights and warriors that fought to defend their homeland. But they were no match for the dragons, and only the forests protected them against complete extermination.

Everything changed when the Junes eliminated almost all dragons. The Aro tribes grew, and soon their forests and swamps were too small for their numbers. And then trackers and merchants brought news: the June people were no more. They vanished as though they had never existed. Only ruins of their cities and fortresses remained. So the Aro started moving to the south...

Hmm...

Listen, . If you find more pages, bring them here. See the book on the table? That's where the page is from. There are many books like this in Dale. So keep an eye out and pick up any pages you can find - they will tell you many stories.

And what your eye can't see, the Sage will explain, if you earn his blessing.

Go in peace!
Escort Zarida Fireson to Clear Valley

Catherina trusts me, and I'll do everything to keep it that way. There's nothing better than serving the Queen! One day you'll understand, !

Let's not waste time. I'll tell you everything on the way.

Not again. We opened Umoir to other nations, and the place is now crawling with elves. I don't want to question the Queen's decisions, but they appear to be sowing discord and causing trouble. I don't know why Vseslav does nothing about it, but this isn't my problem.

Anyway, welcome to Clear Valley, . We have a difficult task ahead of us, so just get your bearings first. I'll let you know when I need you.
Find Alfred de Delice in the ruins of Veligrad.

I sent Alfred and a few helpers to the ruins of Veligrad. They should scope the area and decide on our next steps.

You need to find them and ask if you can help. I'll join you myself soon, and until then, your task is to find and eliminate any potential obstacles.
There is a grimace of displeasure on Alfred's face. His party must have run into some... difficulties.

Outrageous negligence!

When we entered the ruins, all the gargoyles were asleep. I told my men not to touch them. But no! Someone broke one, and then every other gargoyle came to life. If Christina had anything to do with it...!

But that doesn't matter now. It'll take time to get rid of these stone creatures. Be careful with them, or you'll turn into the same piece of rock.
You don't look like a stone statue, so I assume the gargoyles have been dealt with.
Some gargoyles are still asleep as statues, but they'll wake up soon. Maybe it's vandalism but it's easier to break these statues before they wake up and turn us into the very same thing.

Phew, now we don't need to worry about turning our back to the statues.

Skrakan himself created them to guard the streets and walls of Veligrad. As you can see, it didn't save the city, but you've got to appreciate the elegance of thought and magic that went into it.

Have they told you that the local sorcerers created gargoyles to guard the city?

Right.

Of course the dumb rocks didn't help anyone. Those sorcerers were burned to a crisp, and the gargoyles are still sitting in the ruins.

As you can see, they make things difficult... The wisest course of action would be to destroy them all. And remember - if you want something dead to defend you, become a summoner.
Exactly. Practice showed who was right, summoners or sorcerers.
Find and free the sorcerers turned to stone.
Alfred seems to have fallen victim to some magic. You need to free him from the stone shackles. Other summoners in the ruins will also need help.

Is everyone alive? That’s good. I'll have a word with each of you later.

Especially with Andrea.
Help the summoners gather the undead in the ruins of Veligrad.
I'm glad Alfred and the others are okay. Their work is very important to us. But you are not done here yet. Find them and ask if you can help them in any way.
The work is in full swing! Thanks to your help, we gathered a lot of zombies for our army. Just a few more, and it will be a force to be reckoned with.
Put to rest and then raise again 7 Veligrad fighters.

Just look at that... They walk around here as through it's completely normal. They seem to be busy with something. I guess we'll have to put them to rest again before they can serve us! Put them to rest and then use the Horn to subjugate them!

However!

Some of the dead refuse to obey! They seem to be under another influence, it's clearly not something they wanted when they were alive... They said something about a banner?

Someone commands them!
Put to rest and then raise again 7 Veligrad fighters.

The backbone of every army, even the undead one, are ordinary fighters.

So we need those as well, so the easiest way to increase our numbers is to raise everyone who can walk and arm them with a weapon.

Our weapon situation is not ideal at this time, but numerous Veligrad defenders are buried here... some of the metal might still be salvageable. We might even find mithril or adamantine.

Right, why am I discussing this with you? Go to the ruins and raise some fighters for us.

Is your task clear, , or will you mess up again?
Wow, the dead are accounted for, and you are intact, too. You are smarter than you look.
Find the general and fulfill his request.

These dead are controlled by someone else. They are all muttering something about their commander - it sounds like they still follow his orders. But we haven't seen any commanders here. Here, I'll let you control one of the dead. Find out what's going on.

This... is very interesting!

So they were controlled by a Xadaganian commander? Even though they weren't Xadaganian themselves? He must have a strong will even in the afterlife if he can bend others to his wishes. That's an amazing discovery.

Well, now we'll have an easier time controlling these soldiers.

Oh la la! These girls are very stubborn. We've reached an understanding with a few, but I could use your help.

You see, these wonderful creatures are already controlled by... someone. I haven't been able to find out more. We'll use the old recipe: put them to rest, then raise them again. They become obedient after that.

At least, they should...
Oh, I heard their screams. They spoke about fault, retribution, atonement... I think I'm starting to understand.

Just skeletons won't be enough to build an army, the elves are right about that. We'll need Banshees. Girls that never found rest.

Personally I'd rather not listen to their wailing. But I have you, so you'll be the one to gather those still wandering the ruins.

Go to that valley of sorrow, . Put those creatures to rest and raise them again on our side.
Now we have someone else to cry about things.
Find out who controls the banshees and resolve the issue.

Someone is keeping these girls here, and we need to find out who's doing it. To avoid killing them needlessly, you should disguise yourself as one of them and find out what's going on. But be careful! If any of them gets angry with you, your disguise will vanish.

So, will you do it?

What a beautiful and dark story... an inquisitor that condemned his beloved witch. He should've known what a woman scorned is capable of!

Anyway, I'm really glad it has been resolved. I'll talk to the girls myself. They will probably agree to direct their natural vindictiveness at a new enemy.

I'm very grateful for your help.
Help Sea Drift collect his bones and belongings.

Hello, greenhorn! Are you one of those who want to command the dead?

Then we have... whatchamacallit... A conflict of interest. The dead that roam the ruins owe me a debt. And your knife-eared friend told me this debt won't let you put them under your control. I don't need them, but I won't let them go until they return what's mine.

There you have it. Let's do this one thing. We'll both benefit. Here it is: these rats ate my bones and stole my stuff. I dread to think what happened to my little pal Jack. If someone finds my belongings and retrieves my bones from a few dead bellies, I'll be willing to talk.

Deal? Come on, you don't really have a choice, he he.

Ha...! Ha ha ha ha!

Alive! Whole!

Oh well, not exactly alive, but definitely whole. Two missing bones don't count. You and the knife-eared did well. I'm a man of my word, so I'll do my part. Take your zombies.

There's something I need to find here...
Examine the remains on the Corrupted Hill to find out where mighty warriors are buried.

Catherina is wrong! Our future army will be strong and sturdy. But we'll have to pick our material carefully.

, Grimwald will assist you. Yes, that's my Guard. He can inspect remains in the area and figure out which corpses we need to reanimate and which ones are better left alone. You just need to mark mighty warriors.
Good. These markers will help you direct the power of the ritual into reanimating the strongest corpses.
Get rid of grave worms on the battlefield

It's no wonder some zombies are falling apart. Just look around... there are so many corpse-eating worms in the area. Battlefields attract them like a feast.

They are our competition - we need these bodies, too. And I'd rather they were undamaged. Be a dear - kill them all.
Good. No one can disturb us now.
Get rid of the grave worms on the battlefield and report to Nawlad Jeer.

When Leviathan struck, many people died in Veligrad.

That's why you see so many grave worms. It's been years, but they still have no shortage of food.

Of course, the Blight helped... sowed these fields generously again. But now we're interested in the dead ourselves, and the worms are eating them.

So the more worms you kill, , the better. But it will take you more than one try... They are really hard to get rid of.
Did you enjoy killing worms, ? Come back again.
Help Dakkar carry out the ritual that will raise the dead.

Now let's get to work. To raise the dead warriors around here, I'll need a brave and agile assistant. Take my Necrosphere. If you see any remains, give me a sign. I'll direct a flow of magic into it, and all the dead nearby will rise from the ground.

That's very odd. Some of the undead refuse to obey. Something is not right...

Perhaps... they are under some kind of influence. Or someone is controlling them.
Raise 40 skeletons on the Corrupted Hill and report to Nawlad Jeer.

You know what my grandfather used to say?

"Raise them all, you'll sort them out later."

Time is pressing, that elf keeps sending me notes, asking how it's going and where the new warriors are.

So go the battlefield and raise them all. If any corpse makes a fuss and tries to hit you - hit them right back. Once they calm down, raise them again.

What are you waiting for? Go, !
Some of them are too capricious. Now, now. Stop whining, it's your duty now - to serve me. Ha ha.
Find the restless spirit by following its traces.

There's a ghost that appears now and then, trying to interfere with our work. Have you seen it?

It looks like our spells awakened quite a few souls that were at rest in these ruins...

But our mission cannot wait!

Let's finish this. I'll give you an artifact that detects ghostly traces. You can use it to find traces nearby and follow them to the ghost's hideout. Find out what it wants. You're good at solving the dead's problems, so go!

You are looking at an old grave. Someone important is buried here. The epitaph is barely visible, but you can see fragments of words. "H..re r..sts G..len..l, a p..werful s..rcer..ss and k..eper of Vel..grad wond..rs."
Summon Galenel's spirit and pacify her.
It appears that Galenel passed away a long time ago. But her restless soul is still wandering around Veligrad. She is trying to disrupt our work. You should ask her what her problem is.
Why... Why are you doing this?
Talk to Galenel and take her to Dakkar
What do you want now? I'll happily throw you and your friends out. Now talk before I get angry!
Galenel? The one? I don't believe my ears... I never thought I'd meet her in person. We have a lot to discuss.

Pathetic fool!

I am Galenel, a loyal apprentice and Herald of Skrakan's, the hero of Yazes who defeated the Great Mage Urd. I am the keeper of Veligrad Tower, library, and Skrakan's artifact storage!

h: Why do you keep interfering with our work?

t:
Save the world? From what?

What are you talking about? Demons, gods... That sounds like a drunkard's tale!
h: We need the residents of Veligrad to save the world from the dark demons of the god Nihaz.

t: Go to the Corrupted Hill with Dakkar

It's time to gather our forces.

It's easier to raise and subjugate those that are already in the ground. There's a battlefield nearby where a lot of people died - Corrupted Hill. We'll start there.
We're here. Just look around you! So many great warriors are waiting for a chance to hold a weapon again.
Find the witch's lair, defeat her, and obtain a scroll fragment.

Now that we're paying attention, I'm actually starting to sense something.

Some unknown magic! Someone's raising the dead.

Hmm... A very interesting enchantment. Perhaps we should check it out, ?

I'm afraid that other... summoner might disrupt our plans. Persuade them to stop.

Wow! What do you have there? A scroll? Ancient spells? And some local witch had them?

She didn't write them, that's for sure! Look at the words... It's an old Xadaganian script. I'd say the scroll is about 300-400 years old.

We need to take it to Zayan, let him decipher it... Perhaps we'll learn more.
Lead the Veligrad fighters to the Flooded Garden

I want to see how long my zombies can follow an order without my direct control. I suggest you check if our wards can make it to the Flooded Garden. I'll send a few Veligrad undead there, and you will escort them. Make sure they don't wander off or get distracted along the way.

I'll give you a special horn that will let you control them.

, if you notice anything strange in their behavior - let me know.

Has the party made it?

Disobeyed, you say? Yes, that's what I thought. I've never had this much trouble controlling the undead before. We got rid of all the creatures that exerted control over the local corpses, and yet...

Not everyone, apparently. There's one left. Galenel says she sensed another ghost in her tower. A very powerful one. She doesn't know who it might be...
Lead the Veligrad fighters to the Flooded Garden and report to Navlod Koshunsky

Have I told you the undead are useless? No?

I'm saying it now. They are dumb. Their brains decomposed while they were in the ground.

But what do we need? We need them to be able to follow simple orders. March in line, for example.

You'll get on that. Go to the ruins and lead a troop from there to the Flooded Garden.

I wonder if two dummies can teach each another anything?
Ha, they made it. Honestly, I had doubts.
Discuss with Wigo the terms of a possible alliance with House de Doucer.

I hope you understand that you need to find a way to enlist the vampires' help, . Their current leader Wigo de Doucer has been notified of your plans to visit them. He seems to be willing to talk... Be careful and don't blow this chance. I only know that he's arrogant, and you'll have to play up to his ego.
You need to understand: favor for a favor, blood for blood...
I welcome you to our abode - Amarantha!

I know why you're here. It's strange, isn't it? You live your life and close your eyes to our existence, convinced that there will never be a time when you need our help. Life is full of twists and turns. I'm aware of the kind of help you require, but what can you offer in return?

Yes, yes, it's all very interesting but I have no time for chit-chat. The last assignment before we can move on to more serious matters is Abelar. He commands respect but I'm not certain whether he is... in full control of his mental faculties. His issues are likely to be a figment of his imagination, but you must go and ascertain if that's true.
h: I've dealt with Edward's problems. It was unrequited love...

t: I'm counting on that. Of course, we have no intention of expanding our borders, but it can help us... improve our defenses somewhat. In any case, I have a few more tasks for you - of lesser significance. Our dear Edward, the soul of Amarantha, has been out of sorts. Something caused this, and I charge you with the task of resolving it.
h: I helped Genevieve. Soon Amarantha will be able to make use of cloning equipment.

t: Good news. I suppose I can give you a more difficult task now. Genevieve is working on something that would allow us to face groups of armed villagers without fear. Go to her, she'll give you the details. You'd be surprised how much we've learned about cloning technology.
h: I helped Angie de Doucer. I believe the problems with food supply in Amarantha will be resolved soon.

t: Help the vampires of Amarantha with their problems.

I know everything about my brethren's troubles, but I can't always help them. So you'll handle it, . It's not easy to gain trust. Everyone has their troubles and worries. Listen carefully and remember:

Angie de Doucer is responsible for food supply, and we've had problems with it recently. I'm sure you understand: we need... specific food. She will tell you the details.

Come back to me for another quest when you're done. That is all. You can go.
Are you done with my task yet? Don't waste my time!
Excellent. According to the reports I've received, you handled everything. We can get to the real favors now. Remember? Blood for blood...

Finally, some help! As you can probably guess, we have trouble procuring blood.

Where can you get it? From the locals or animals. The locals are not an option, but the animals in the area are all infected, so it won't do either.

We'll have to resort to extreme measures. The Blight is leaving the land, and various creatures are returning. I've seen unicorns nearby, and I'd rather not do it, but...

We'll have to borrow their blood. I'll give you an artifact that will put them into a trance, giving you time to collect some blood, but be careful - if you take too much, I won't be responsible for any side effects!
What about unicorns? Are you done? There's no time.

They say whoever drinks unicorn blood will be forever cursed... But it can't get any worse for us, can it? Let's see what we have...

Well, that's something... We can consider the experiment successful. I hope the unicorns are alright? I'll analyze the results. You can go.
Help Genevieve de Doucer repair the cloning equipment.

Finally! Someone willing to help! I'm very grateful to you. We have a practical task, I've prepared everything. See the cloning equipment? These can still be utilized. They just need to be calibrated. I'll give you the tools and parts, and you'll find the instruction near the equipment. I'm sorry, I don't have time to instruct you - you'll figure it out, I'm sure!
What took you so long? Here are the tools, go! We have much to do...
Great, we can start tests soon! I hope we all enjoy the results...
Help Edward de Doucer with his personal problems
Oh, what a mess. Why does this happen to me? My heart can't take this, and I can't even tell anyone...
Oh... maybe you could help me?
Oh, a load off my mind! I can finally do something else instead of constantly worrying... Thank you! I'll put this head to use...

h: They say you have a problem...

t: How dreadful! This is embarrassing! Go away, leave me alone...
h: Yes! It's all anyone is talking about!

t: Aren't they sweet? So observant! But they know nothing...
h: No, no. Some people just noticed that you're sad.

t: You...? Well, you don't look like an expert in these matters and I've never seen you before in my life...
Wow, that's impressive! But why? It's not the... Ah, whatever. Give it here, I'll find some use for it. Just don't tell anyone.
Find out where the girl with pies disappears to every night.

So they finally sent someone! You're a professional, right?

Alright, there's no time... Every night, the girl next door goes somewhere... with pies!

Why are you looking at me like that?! Just think about it - a VAMPIRE I'm not acquainted with TAKES PIES into the blighted forest every night!

Look into this. I promise something weird is happening. Wait somewhere nearby until she shows up and follow her discreetly.
So have you found out what's going on? I can't sleep because of this...
See? I told you! This is absolutely bizarre... Perhaps we shouldn't tell anyone about this. They'll think we are both crazy. They can't see beyond their nose...
Buttress Wigo's authority by eliminating all potential competition.

Let's get to important matters. Here, in our city, no one questions my authority. However, there's a group of Separatists.

When you become a vampire, you change... Why did we follow Armando like lambs? He was our Patriarch... but most importantly, we were unable to disobey. It was part of our new nature. The part that makes us more like animals rather than rational beings. Alas, you can't resist the call for long. A strong vampire will have followers, and they don't need rivals.

Unfortunately, I have those. Marishka, Alira, and Verona - they used to hold powerful positions in our House. Together we escaped to Umoir... and then it turned out we had different views on what our priorities should be. They have their own idea of what they want... I'm afraid there's only one way to deal with this. Kill them all. I could lie to you and say they are bloodthirsty monsters who slaughter people... But it's not true. They are no more monstrous than we are. But you'll have to kill them all if you want an alliance.

You have doubts? You don't want to spill innocent blood? I was like you once. So you have a choice - kill them and form an alliance with me, or spare them - but then Amarantha will not help you. Decide.

That's quite a story... It sounds like vampires are a more of a problem than a solution. At least you found another part of Urd's scroll, which is fortunate... And suspicious. Alright, there's another solution. Talk to me when you are feeling better.
Wow, we don't get guests often...
Report to Vseslav about the defense of the outskirts.

I assume Clear Valley is safe now.

But my duty to the Queen is to protect her subjects. So even though the threat was eliminated, there's still a lot you can do to help.

Vseslav spends all his time in Clear Valley. I suspect he has new problems every day. It would be great if you could help him.

Go see him and ask what you can do.

Good, . I'm glad we have nothing to fear from the direction of the Outpost.

But these lands are far from peaceful.

If you start helping people around Clear Valley, they will eventually start trusting you. Trust is very important, as you know.

I can give you new tasks every day, if you show up. So don't forget the old man.
Find the third part of Urd's notes.

Listen to me carefully. I found the source of our problems.

Every time they gathered an army of the undead, the summoner that raised them wasn't the only one commanding them. Someone needs to keep them in check. In the Dead City it was the Dead King, on Gipat - Nihaz's dragons, in Castle Blight - Mor'Ghuun, and here on Umoir - the Xadaganian general, inquisitor, and Urd's shadow.

In short, we need strong and powerful "generals of the dead". At any rate, to accomplish something like this, we'll need the third part of Urd's notes. The Xadaganian arrived at this conclusion on his own, but the required rituals are described in that missing part of the scroll.

I admit we don't know where it is, but we have... an idea. A local wise woman went missing here in the Dale. It's a strange occurrence for a quiet place like this, and she lived in a remote place far away from people. Go there, find her house and try to learn what you can.

You found... the third part of Urd's notes? I really didn't think it would be that... Easy. No, I'm not belittling your efforts, but these lucky coincidences are too suspicious. Fine, I'll need some time to decipher it, and then we'll decide on our next steps.
Collect 10 books in Amarantha and return them to Philip de Doucer.

! Amarantha needs your help again, but it's a fairly easy task. You see, vampires got too lazy under Wigo's rule. They don't care about personal growth anymore. I'm trying to change that, but it's... difficult. They like to read but I've been unable to make them treat books with respect - they leave them all over the place then have trouble finding them. Collect at least ten of them and bring them here.
Wonderful! I'm sure it will happen again in a few days, but maybe they'll learn something...
Wait, do I know you? Your face looks familiar... Never mind.

! Genevieve needs your help this time. I don’t know why it affects the cloning devices, but our magical fields interfere with their operation... So they need to be calibrated daily. Vampires have no patience for that work, but you seem to be doing alright. Genevieve left her tools for you. Report to her once you're done.
What's taking so long? The day will be over before you're done...
Great, the research continues! Just no more questions, please. And don't come here at night. Just in case.

I'm moving us forward! I'm in charge of artifacts, arts, and sciences. Our curse is not an excuse to stagnate.

My current interest is Gorluxor's cloning apparatus. As you can guess, we managed to grab a few when we escaped the Tower. I picked up a few things while the old man was away painting my friends in the nude.

I also have a few blood samples... not just from the humans in the village, although I secured those first. The cultists had a special bank that allowed them to revive Sarn's servants. I got hold of the bank, but it will take me a while to sort through it.

Unfortunately, there's not much time. I'm expected to provide results soon.

The world around us is cruel, and Wigo says we need to be able to defend ourselves, and this is a great opportunity to make us more powerful, even if it's dangerous. But I promise we'll be careful.

It's easier than it looks! You attach a sensor - and if you see the indicator move upward, you reduce power, and when it moves downward, increase it. Watch it for about half a minute, and it should stabilize. These devices were created by a genius, so even an idiot can use them.
h: How do I calibrate the cloning equipment?

t: Take the gift to Edward's beloved in Clear Valley.

I have... an embarrassing request... You already know Edward and his troubles. Fortunately, no one else has tried to entice her away, but he hasn't stopped worrying. Now he wants to send regular gifts to her so she doesn't forget him, and not by mail, but with you! Edward's administrative skills are too valuable to Amarantha, so I hope you will fulfill this strange request.

I know it's not the first time you hear this, but... Angie needs unicorn blood again. I don't know what she's researching but they clearly take more time than we expected... Although, why not? Our situation is not as dire now, and we should be prepared for the future. Here's the amulet, you know the drill. When you have 10 flasks, take them to Angie.
Yes, another batch! I'll be able to continue my research for another couple of days... Why are you standing there? Go, it's not your business!
I was roughed up pretty bad... My ribs hurt!
What camp? Are you blind? The ogres threw our boys into cages. They wanna eat them alive! Nope, either we get to safety together or we all die.
Find the missing companions in the snow.

So when the Vegvisir transported you, you were all dumped in the snow?

At any rate, you should check the snowdrifts nearby for your companions. They're probably somewhere in there.

, I hope we really are on Isa... According to legend, the frosts here were often so severe that birds froze in mid-flight, and now I'm willing to believe these stories...

Vegvísir transported us, but I don't see Waterlily and Ratatoskr... I hope they'll turn up later.

And what about Murk?

Something strange is going on here! I sense evil emanating from this piece of ice! And Murk... it's like his mind is immersed in a fog...

We need to awaken our friend! , do something!

Damn it! I've never encountered such a hun-hurr before... Whatever is in this ice chunk, it's as powerful as a thousand evil spirits. It almost broke me... I couldn't disobey and had to... I had to! I had to break this ice!

, I really don't like this!
Chief... call... battle... glory... memory... awakening...
Dig into the mysterious snowdrift, then gather firewood and help them warm up.

! I haven't seen this much snow since a blizzard once passed over Coldberg! Then the mines were filled with snow, and Sigurd ordered everyone to grab a shovel! But here it seems to be normal!

I'm glad we found Murk, but Waterlily is still missing! And without her, it will be difficult to save the Ash Tree. Most likely, she is still in one of the snowdrifts! I suggest looking... Digging until we find her!

Brr... Brrr... It's... s-s-so... c-c-c-cold...

Th-th-thaaank... you... Brr...

Listen, kylys!

It's not just white Pridens that inhabit these dreadfully cold lands! Do you hear the howling, zur? A pack of hungry and angry wolves is hunting nearby!

I'm sure they are on our tracks already, eysh! They are going to attack any minute now.

You know what, I'll look after our little friends, and you go kill these wolves with sharp teeth and powerful paws...
We must kill those wolves! Or they would attack at the most inopportune moment!
Great hunting, friend! My hair stood on end when I heard that terrible howling!
Ugh... we need to break the ice!

Oh, it's warm now...

Hello! Are you not from around here? But... it's incredible! There has never been anyone but locals here! After Yok came, the rest of the world perished! Did it not?

It really is incredible! No one will believe me unless they see you!

Are you... are you an Orc? An actual Orc?! And you even have fangs?! Damn. And you don't want to kill me? Aren't you going to break everything around here? Wow!Are you... are you a black Urun? And you speak the common tongue? And you're not going to kill anyone? Wow!And you are the Gibberlings? But I see you are not local. The clothes are unusual, and you are acting... strangely. You are clearly outlanders! So the Gibberlings still exist out there? Wow!And what kind of creature are you? I don't have a clue. It's the first time I've seen someone like you. Wow!And what kind of creature are you? I don't have a clue. It's the first time I've seen someone like you. Wow!And what kind of creature are you? I don't have a clue. It's the first time I've seen someone like you. Wow!And what kind of creature are you? I don't have a clue. It's the first time I've seen someone like you. Wow!And what kind of creature are you? I don't have a clue. It's the first time I've seen someone like you. Wow!

And my name is Gerda. I keep my Winter Watch on this side of the island. Want me to tell you about this place?

To be honest, it was just bad luck during my shift... If the Urun hadn't appeared... Anyway, thank you for saving me! I've even composed a verse in your honor. Here, listen:

"The maiden stood on winter watch,

The Urun came like a storm,

And when I hid in the snow,

Glorious warriors saved Gerda!"

Great, huh?

I understand that you want to get to Skalgard... That trail leads there...

Of course I can't go with you - I need to be on watch, you understand...

But... after last month's destruction, the road is dangerous! Only those who know the secret paths can make it through, and besides... I would like to see what happens when you show up in Skalgard!

So, shall we go?

, are you awake?

Oh, bother... How terrible... What do I do now? It's all my fault...

I shouldn't have gone with you. Bad luck dogs me...

Sigh...

And now I'm in trouble.
Meet the ravens, the Spirits of the First.

Hello, hello! You smell like honey… Mmm!

! I hear you have visited the keeper Surt... Is it true that he says my amulet was crafted by the Zvergs?

This is getting more and more interesting! So it's over 200 years old! Too bad Surt doesn't know anything else. But maybe someone does know? On Isa you can find those who remember those times... I'm talking about the ravens! We have already met them - these are Huginn and Muninn, two of the First that remain on Isa still!

And don't forget to drink more mead before we leave here. We're going back out into the cold!

Caw! My feathers are black as night, my eye sees the one who arrived on the squirrel. I knew that you would come to me, asking about the eternal wanderer who left the world after the leaves on the trees changed two hundred times!

Do you want to know what happened? Enter the path that is forgotten?

Caw! Since you come here, longing to see one of the eternal wanderers, are you certain that he is where you hope to find him?

There are some who were not destined to board a stone boat! The frost took them, encasing them in eternal ice. Fear them, because they can rise as draugr, bringing the deadly cold further - to everyone who is still warm and breathing...

Are you not afraid? Then descend into the dark cold gorge on the Path of the Forgotten and set their bones on fire!
Do not pity the dead. They yearn for rest...

You did not fear those who are no longer breathing, who are as cold as everything around them. You looked into their dead eyes...

But the one you are looking for was not among them. The bones that burned today were not his! Caw!
Burn 10 frozen skeletons and report to Raven Huginn.

I had a prophetic dream!

Cold winds are still blowing over Isa... Frost's malice disturbs the dead. I'm talking about those who were not destined to board a stone boat! They can rise as the Draugar, bringing the deadly cold further - to everyone who is still warm and breathing...

Their bones still lie on the Path of the Forgotten in a dark, cold gorge. Go there and burn their bones!
Do not pity the dead. They yearn for rest...
Well, hopefully we don't need to worry about Draugar now. Many of the dead still remain unburied, and we need to ensure they won't come for us.

Are you looking for the eternal wanderer? Remember - not everyone boards a stone boat! There are those who escaped the flames but became food for the Valravns! Flesh eaters flock to every battle, hungry for feasts among the dead! Is the one you are looking for destined to become one of those who are ripped apart by beaks of scavengers?

The answer is there, in the gorge. Enter it and disperse the ghostly ravens! Enter the Path of the Forgotten, and you will find what you want...
Valravns always flocked to the feast where the bodies of the dead lay!

There was no fear in you when you entered that path, and the Valravns retreated. The one you are looking for was not among those they pecked at.

He was not destined to become a feast for crows!
Kill 12 Valravns and report to Muninn

Greetings, friend!

As the Elder of Skalgard, it is my duty to respond to threats to our settlement and all the Gibberlings... However, I do not have the manpower to handle everything, so your help will be appreciated.

I have received reports that the Valravns are gathering on the Path of the Forgotten! After they feast on the bodies of the fallen, they could pose a serious threat to our settlements.

So you need to chase them off again. I'm itching to grab a hammer and do it myself. But I have you, so I entrust it to you!
Valravns feast on the bodies of the dead!
Good. There should be no attacks from that direction today. But there are other threats on Isa! Frost is getting worse!
Meet with Unn in the Harbor.

Caw! If you did not find the ancestor among the draugrs, or among those Valravns feed on, then it means one thing - you need to travel to the Misty Harbor.

You will find him among the graves of the Gibberlings! But remember: by looking for the secret that has been veiled for many years, you bring the prophecy closer...

What an interesting place...

I see what I previously heard only in legends. Our ancestors talked about this, but earlier those ships were wooden, and now the dead set off on their last journey on stone boats!

But... to the point...

We need to be more careful! Are you listening, ?

This is... The rustle of the Threads that were cut by Kharyskhan's atrocities! They left their echo on this land, and now that Kharyskhan returned, the echoes of broken destinies also came back. The spirits lurk in the fog of the Harbor, and not all of them are in good... spirits.
They wander now without meaning and purpose, awakened...

The spirits fell asleep... But only for the time being. While Kharyskhan is free, they will rise again, thirsting for revenge... And in their anger they will attack everyone they see...

, we need to stop the villain. Then they will finally be at peace...

, you know we thought about the fate of Isa and came to the realization: the Gibberlings were seafarers who often returned here, to their home, which means there could be descendants of the same clan on Isa and beyond! We would love to find our relatives, because there are only two of us in this harsh world! We really miss our dead brother... Once we even wanted to take Sigurd as a brother, but the orc deceived us... There is no ritual of unity, he said.

But it is quite possible that among the souls resting here might be our distant uncles and aunts. We picked some flowers in the valley - we want to honor the memory of our relatives...

But the problem is, we don't know how to figure out who is who! Weaver's Vision would be very useful here, and Unn says you have it. You should be able to use it at the right moment. Don't worry, you haven't lost it. We're lucky you can see the Threads!

Please find those who might be our relatives!
Oh, where might our ancestors be?
So all Gibberlings are related? Well, yes, how could it be otherwise? All our families come from Ase and Emla, it's true!
Examine the memory stones and find Gerda's ancestors.

Oh, there are so many graves here!

! Alright, let me know when you're ready to start looking for my relatives! I'm sure it will be pretty easy to find them - I remember their names, so... you just have to look!

If we figure it out, we’ll understand where my ancestors got this… meteorite pendant...
It can't be! I think I figured out where we should look for them...
Go to Isa and visit the Strand, Stalwart, Nutlet, and Smile Families, then report to the Sharp Family.

The letter reads as follows:

"! Hello, hello! It's so strange writing a letter to someone! And it will be delivered somewhere outside of Isa! Incredible!

We have put things in order after the Urun attack, and now we can offer you all sorts of tasks! Broddie wants to protect Skalgard, the Thread Keepers see different predictions, and my brothers and I want to join the Winter Watch! And everyone needs your help, so come back soon!

And don't think we'll just make you run around for nothing. You will be rewarded, of course! The Smile and Nutlet Families are working on that, in fact! You'll see what we have, and there is a little advance attached to the letter for you!"

You can go back to Isa and visit Gerda, her brothers, and other Gibberlings who have new tasks and rewards for you.
I knew you would be back!

I... oh, I mean WE are so happy to see you again!

Have you seen the penguins? They are adorable, aren't they? But the squirrels are cute, too! As you can see, there are lots of things to do on Isa. Don't think the place became boring and empty after your adventures! And if you help us, the reward will be worth it!
Discuss the Ritual of Thread Weaving with everyone involved.

Marvelous! So that's how it was. Our predecessors took this secret with them on their eternal journey!

, we are afraid to reveal this secret to the world! What if the prophecy really comes true, and then Isa perishes? But now it's not just the fate of Isa that is at stake.

If we want to save the Ash Tree, then we have no other choice. The Ash Tree is already dying, and if we do not do this, it will definitely wither, and then Isa is doomed. Another future that awaits us is still unclear! So...let's take that risk!

We are ready to discuss the ritual...
Be sure to talk to everyone and get their opinion.

Well, that's good! We will also call on the spinners from the Fishermen and Meadmakers to strengthen the ritual. But we need to start preparing right now. We are going to the Ash Tree and we will tell fortunes all night, and we will send for your friends in the morning.

You can rest for now.
O-ho-ho! Children! Well, you are masters of getting into trouble. All is well that ends well.
Return the sixth fragment of the Carpet of Fate to its place.

, I hear you have found the missing carpet? I knew something was missing! Let's get the lost piece back.

It's not right to make changes to the story, even if we don't like it. Bad things come from this. It's important to remember how everything was: both good and bad. There's a lesson in that.

As for Koll, all secrets will be revealed sooner or later.
Come on, I can't wait to see the full picture!

I wonder why this fragment was put up at first, then removed?

Were those Thread Keepers afraid to conceal the true Fate? And then later, perhaps, caution outweighed everything else?

Maybe it was Frigga who gave Koll the fragment about him? What do you think, ?
Travel to the Mead Hall in Skalgard.

Annika, there she is! HeShe is the one everyone is talking about! Look, look...

Hello, ! It's me, Akke. Remember? The gates! I let you into the city! Meet Annika, my sister I told you about.

We invite you to a feast! Broddie told me to throw a feast in your honor and to celebrate the victory over Urun!

Everyone is already there, we're only waiting for you so we can start! And your black-tailed friend, too!

There she is – the hero of this day! Yes, such feats have not been performed in our land for a long time!

I think sooner or later the skalds will compose sagas about you, too, !

Ahhh! A real flying ship! On Isa!

Ahhh!

Oh, look, we're all united now! It's so strange! And so amazing!

Everything seems to be in place! We invited those we wanted to invite, and if we forgot someone, I hope they'll forgive us!

A great feast awaits us! , would you like to see how we celebrate the feats of glorious warriors here on Isa?

Now you'll find out! Enjoy the festivities. Today you can feast to your heart's content! Skol!

! Wake up! Wake up! Please wake up!

Oh, damn!
Eliminate 30 enemies in Skalgard, help 5 wounded, and find out what happened.

Ohh, ! It's a nightmare! The Urun attacked out of nowhere! We must fight back, or else it's going to end badly! And there are many wounded - we need to help them, too!

Oh-oh-oh!
Oh, it’s good that you managed to bring back everyone! Now I'll look after them, and you go to the Ash Tree. Don't delay!

In the middle of the night, when the feast was in full swing, enemies broke into the city!

The Urun came from mountain burrows, Sabertooths came from the forest, Werebears sailed across the sea and flooded the harbor, and a Jotunn almost broke down the gate when he came out of the forest!

Everyone who could not fight fled from the city to the harbor. Styr prepares a boat to help people escape.

And I... I'm holding on with all my might and waiting for you!
Find the missing children and bring them to Styr and Hadne in the Fjord.

! Please help! We need to find the missing Gibberling children!

Most of the families with children have already left the city, but some of them are missing.

I know they can hide well, but I'm really afraid that the Urun with their scent will find and devour the little ones!
Get to the Eternal Harbor, find Kharyskhan and kill him

Yes, yes, my sister and I will take care of everyone! The children and all the others who fled from Skalgard! You need to hurry - Kharyskhan went to the Eternal Harbor and took Gerda and the Sharp brothers with him! I dread to imagine what will happen if you delay!
Oh, no... No! No, no, no!
Enter the Hall of Fates, save the Gibberlings, and defeat Skulnar the Northwind.

, that sneaky orc tricked you!

Now both he and our little friends are trapped in the Hall of Fate!

Yes, yes, right here, under the Prophetic Ash Tree, is a powerful place of power - the entrance to the Hall! And the spinners are holding the door wide open right now!

That means the old orc figured it all out!

Go after him!
It's... of course, everything is incredible! I've never seen anything like it. I hope it wasn't all in vain!
Find the All-Mother's Fate in the Hall and give her hope.

! Wait!

You and I have one more important thing to do in the Hall. Do you still remember why we came here?

We finally have a chance to reach the All-Mother's Thread through her child, her first tree in Sarnaut! And learn how we can mollify her and save our dying Great Trees.

 Please find her Thread in the Hall. Try to help.

All right, now go!
Go to the Hall and find the Fate of the All-Mother! Hurry! I won't be able to maintain my astral projection here indefinitely!
Hope? It's a great power. Even when darkness swallows the world and faith dries up, hope remains. It moves us forward in the most difficult time when there is nothing left.
Talk to your friends in Skalgard.

, it took you a long time to recover after the ritual! We were starting to worry... But maybe you just need to rest.

Well, Isa is now open to all Gibberlings, and the first ships have already landed on the shores of the allod. You should go meet all your new and old acquaintances and see how they are doing. I think they have a lot to say...
I think everyone wants to talk to you!

Well, that's all, right? Is our adventure coming to an end?

You will come back to Isa someday, right? We will be very, very happy to see you again!

See you soon, ! May your Thread be strong!

We want to speak with those Gibberlings that have been separated from Isa for a long time. They have their own history, quite a dramatic one, and it is time to weave our history and theirs together. I am also concerned over the fate of the New Isa. I am sure that even though Isa has been found, they should not abandon this undertaking. The treaty with the dragon Nordrak may also be important to all of us. After all, Dragons and Trees are part of the whole.

, I have a task for you... We need to tell Yasker everything that happened here. I hope the great leader of the Empire will temper justice with mercy.

And one more request: do not tell anyone how to get to Isa. Let this remain the secret of the Gibberlings of Isa and those they choose to invite here.

Interesting news! Perhaps you are not hopeless after all, . If Isa's Gibberlings had showed up a few years ago, I would've been extremely worried that the League would bring in new forces to fight us. But now it's not even clear if the Gibberlings will stay in the League!

Okay, so be it, I will forget your defeat in Eden.

We have new problems here. The allod Jigran, lost and forgotten by everyone. It has become the new capital of Sarnaut. And the situation there - the news make your blood run cold. I've been looking for someone to send there. I think you will be a good candidate.

We must prepare, but for now… wait. I will send for you when the time comes.

I didn't believe Isa would ever be found! We kinda got used to this idea - that's why we began to build a new house on the Frozen Frontier. And then everything changed again. Now it takes some getting used to. And, of course, all sorts of questions arise. Do you remember that the Gibberlings joined the League to find Isa? Many will now ask - why do we need the League? But I don't think we should leave it so quickly.
h: What are your thoughts on what happened?

t: Wow... This is Isa? I can't even believe it, to be honest!
Persuade the Elder of the Fishing Clan to catch Lyngbakr.

, what do we do now?!

This big fish ate my bag! My poor bag... And with it my amulet!

My mom wore it, and my granny wore it, and my great-grandmother, and… Waah!

And I lost it! I have nothing left of them!

Oh-oh-oh...

So be it! You will have Lyngbakr, and Gerda will have her trinket.

I wouldn't be Styr Ruff if tomorrow the head of this fish doesn't hang over my hearth!

There you go!

Are you an Orc? I've never seen Orcs, even though I know what they look like... but the war between us is long over, so I hope you won't make a fuss. You won't, will you? And we, the children of the sea, help everyone in times of need.Wow, an actual Priden. I have heard of you, though I have never seen one. You don't really look like Urun. But I am glad to see lost relatives, very glad. We, the children of the sea, help everyone in times of need.

Gerda shouldn't have been there in the first place, my friend!

We guard the road to the south coast. The spinners told no one to go there.

We don't, and no one else should.
h: We have a problem: Gerda lost an important amulet in the mouth of that huge fish

t: Give 5 bottles of Fish Oil to the Gibberlings in the Fjord and ask them to join the hunt.

, you don't think Lyngbakr is a stupid salmon to be hooked, do you?

It takes a team to harpoon such a creature. The best team!

There are many excellent fishermen among us, but some are worthy of a legend. Ricky and Knerr Perch, Halli Hook, Hedda Pike, and Sygga Roach. Well, me too, of course.

Give everyone a bottle of fish oil from me. They know what it means.

I need these five on board, otherwise there will be no hunting!

You will find them along the shore of the fjord, and Sygga likes to freeze her furry ass at the feet of the trio.

And be quick before I change my mind!

What, everyone agreed? Everyone? Even Sygga?

, I'll be damned! I didn't think Ruff's old team would get together again. You know, after that incident with Jon, we never went after big fish together again. It was hard for everyone. Everyone felt guilty, disagreements began...

I don't care about past grievances! But if we're going after Lyngbakr, they are the only ones I'd want at my side.
Wow, I'll be damned! I didn't expect him to call me again after that incident...
h: The Elder asks us to go fishing!

t:
When cold winds blow, only your own fur can save you!

Are you an Orc? I've never seen an Orc before! Only heard of them.You're like the Urun, just black!Aren't you cold without fur?Aren't you cold without fur?Aren't you cold without fur?Aren't you cold without fur?Aren't you cold without fur?Hello, kin! Do you also eat fish back home or do you prefer something else?
Collect 25 pieces of Crab Meat and take it to Ricky Perch.

Like I said, we need bait!

Lyngbakr is not some kind of pike, catfish or beluga! He's quite a gourmet. He'll eat everything he sees, of course, but only if he's really hungry. And if he's full, you'll need a true delicacy to lure him out. I'm talking about Ice Crabs... You see, , they are cautious creatures - they hide as soon as they sense danger, so their delicious tender meat is out of reach.

Therefore Lyngbakr rarely gets crabs for dinner, but when he does, he is completely blissed out.

Fortunately, we have a lot of crabs here on the shore, so it won't be difficult for you to collect some bait. You can open their shells, right?

Mmmm, yum! Get over here, !

For bait, of course. I've eaten enough crab meat to last me a lifetime.
Obtain 25 pieces of Crab Meat and take them to Ricky Perch.

Greetings, friend!

As the Elder of Skalgard, it is my duty to ensure that the settlement is protected, and that everyone is fed and clothed.

Now Isa is constantly receiving guests, among them Gibberlings who lived outside of Isa. We have so many people on Isa these days! Which is great and exciting, of course, but this horde needs to eat. Remember how Ricky Perch asked you to get crab meat? It doesn't matter what he told you about our preferences - we need food right now. And it seems that the most affordable food now is crabs on the shores of the Empty Sea. There are lots of them, and they are delicious, so bring at least twenty five pieces of crab meat - it's not much, but we'll send others to get some as well. We'll make chowder with pepper, mmm... yes!
Remember: we need at least twenty five pieces!
Everyone will be fed today! I hope we'll have enough crabs for a while! However, this doesn't mean we have everything we need!
Obtain 9 servings of Bear Fat, then render them into 3 servings of Bear Grease at the fire. When you are done, take them to Halli Hook.

, it's quite cold here, as you can see! And if you fall into the sea, you will freeze to death. But, as you can see, we have a lot of creatures dwelling here - and somehow they survive in the water, right?

Therefore, we will use some old-fashioned tricks. Let's be like animals! Take bears, for example. They have special fat under their skin, and that's why they don't freeze. So for us the only way to survive in the icy water - is to generously smear Bear Grease all over ourselves.

I never go fishing without Bear Grease! You never know. I might tumble into the water, the fur will get wet, and that’s it - my little brothers will be left alone.
Don't kill more bears than necessary. If we exterminate them all, where will we get the fat? Exactly!

There you go! !
